The Premises shall be used solely for the operation of a [[PERMITTED_USE]]. Any change requires Lessor's prior written consent. Operations shall meet first-class [[USE_STANDARD]] standards and comply with applicable laws.

The Premises shall not be used during the Initial Term or any Renewal Term as: (i) a delicatessen or restaurant whose operations are the same as or similar to a Jason's Deli or whose primary menu items are salads, soups, sandwiches, baked potatoes, or any combination thereof; (ii) a veterinary clinic engaged primarily in the care and treatment of cats; or (iii) a retail boutique whose primary business is the sale of home goods, monogrammed or personalized items, candles, home decorations, drinkware, or jewelry. This list must be reconciled against then-existing tenant exclusives before each lease is issued.

The Initial Term shall commence on [[COMMENCEMENT_DATE]] and expire at midnight, Lafayette, Louisiana time, on [[EXPIRATION_DATE]]. Any possession, rent commencement, construction, or outside-opening dates are [[ADDITIONAL_TERM_DATES]].

A. Premises Base Rent. Lessee shall pay Base Rent according to Schedule G.

Lessee shall be responsible for and shall pay, before delinquency, all taxes, assessments, license fees, and other charges that are levied and assessed against Lessee’s personal property installed or located in or on the Premises, and that become payable during the Initial Term or any renewal thereof.
Section 7.01 - Limitations on Use:
Lessee shall not do, bring or keep anything in or about the Premises that will cause the cancellation of any insurance
covering the Premises. If the rate of any insurance carried by Lessor is increased, as a result of Lessee's use, Lessee shall reimburse Lessor for the amount of such increase.

A. Lessee shall not permit any activity on the premises which may in law constitute a nuisance, public or private, or which may constitute a violation of any environmental laws, or any other laws, ordinances or regulations.

Section 8.01 - Assignment and Subletting:

Lessee shall not sell, mortgage, transfer, assign or sub-let all or any portion of the Premises without the prior written consent of the Lessor, which consent shall be in the sole discretion of the Lessor. Provided however, the Lessor shall not be obligated to consent to any assignment, transfer or sub-let in the event the proposed transferee’s use of the Premises would be in conflict with the provisions of any other lease in the Boulevard Shopping Center Property. Further provided, that in no event shall Lessor's consent to an assignment or subletting by construed as (i) relieving Lessee from the obligation to obtain Lessor's express written consent to any further assignment or subletting or (ii) releasing Lessee from any liability or obligation hereunder whether or not then accrued, and Lessee shall continue to be, fully, jointly and severally liable hereunder. The Lessor may sell, mortgage, transfer or assign its interest in this Agreement at any time without the consent of the Lessee, but such transaction(s) shall be made subject to rights of Lessee under this Lease.
Section 9.01 - Maintenance, Repairs:

Lessee acknowledges that the Premises is in good order and repair and shall surrender the same at termination hereof, in as good condition as received, normal wear and tear excepted. Lessee shall be responsible for all repairs required, excepting the roof, exterior walls and structural foundation (including the electrical and plumbing systems situated in or below the Premises’ concrete slab foundation), which shall be maintained by Les sor. Lessee shall also be responsible for keeping at all times areas immediately adjacent to the Premises, such as sidewalks and parking areas, free and clear of trash and other refuse. Lessee shall promptly repair any damage to any part of the building in which the Premises is located, including but not limited to the roof, exterior walls and structural foundation (including the electrical and plumbing systems in or below the Premises’ concrete slab foundation), in the event such damage is caused by or attributable to the actions or inactions of Lessee, its employees, officers, directors, shareholders, members, partners, representatives, agents, customers, guests, invitees or l icensees, to the extent to which such is not covered by insurance under Section 15.01. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Lessor shall be responsible for the repair and replacement, if necessary, of the heating and air conditioning (“HVAC”) system servicing the Premises provided that (i) the Lessee shall pay the first $ 1,500.00 for each repair visit and fifty -percent (50%) toward the replacement cost of the HVAC system or any component thereof, and (ii) the Lessee maintains, at its own expense, for the full term of this Agreement and any renewal or extensions thereof, a monthly maintenance contract with Butcher Air Conditioning for regular routine maintenance to the HVAC systems and components thereof in the Premises. Further provided, in the event it is determined by the HVAC maintenance provider that the HVAC systems or any component thereof must be replaced and such replacement is made within fifteen (15) days of a repair visit made by such HVAC maintenance provider (“Preceding Repair Visit”) (not including a routine maintenance visit pursuant to a monthly maintenance contract), then the amount paid by the Lessee toward the cost of the Preceding Repair Visit shall be credited toward the Lessee’s obligation to pay fifty (50%) toward the replacement cost of the HVAC system. Lessee further agrees to maintain the Premises in clean and healthful condition and to comply with all laws, ordinances, orders, rules and regulations (state, federal, municipal and any other agencies or bodies having any jurisdiction thereof) with respect to the use, condition or occupancy of the Premises. In discharging the

responsibilities hereunder, Lessee shall utilize the services of bonded, licensed contractors to perform all maintenance or repair work to the Premises. Lessee agrees to hire Broussard & Smith Services or Butcher Air Conditioning, or other agreeable HVAC provider, to perform all maintenance, repairs and replacements of the heating and air conditioning systems and components servicing the Premises.
Section 10.01 - Alterations:

Lessee shall not make any additions, improvements or alterations, structural or otherwise, to the Premises without Lessor’s written consent, which consent shall be in the sole discretion of the Lessor. In making any improvements, additions or alterations that require the consent of Lessor, Lessee, after obtaining Lessor’s consent, shall comply with the following:

A. The improvements or alterations shall not be commenced until seven (7) days after Lessor has received written notice from Lessee stating the date the alternations are to commence and Lessor has consented to same.
B. The improvements or alterations shall be in conformance with all applicable local, state or federal laws and regulations.

Lessee shall have the duty, only if Lessor so requests in writing, to remove from the Premises before the expiration of the term, or within fifteen (15) days after the expiration of the term, any additions, improvements or alterations Lessee has made to the Premises, so long as the removal will not cause structural damage to the Premises, and Lessee, at its cost, shall promptly restore any damage caused by the removal and return the Premises to the condition it was in at the beginning of the Initial Term.
The Lessee shall not cause or permit any mechanic’s liens to be filed against the Premises, and Lessee shall indemnify, hold harmless, and defend the Lessor from and against any and all such liens.

Moreover, any additions, alterations and improvements made by Lessee, with or without consent of the Lessor, no matter how attached to the Premises, shall remain the property of the Lessor unless otherwise stipulated herein, and Lessee expressly waives any right to compensation or reimbursement for any such additions, alterations or improvements which may be made on the Premises. Notwithstanding the above, however, Lessee may remove from the Premises its office supplies, movable office furniture and movable equipment not attached to the Premises provided (a) such removal is made prior to the termination of the term of this Agreement; (b) Lessee is not in default of any obligation or covenant under this Agreement at the time of such removal; and (c) Lessee promptly repairs all damage, no matter how slight, caused by the installation, use or removal of such furniture or equipment. Furthermore, Lessee, or any of its hired architects, engineers, contractors, subcontractors or employees, shall not remove or discard any thing or any item, furniture, fixture, flooring, movable or immovable, etc., without first consulting the Lessor and obtaining Lessor’s written permission.
Section 11.01 - Utilities and Janitorial Services:

Lessee shall pay before same becomes delinquent, all utility and service charges for utilities or services furnished to the Premises or used by the Premises or the Lessee, including, without limitation, electricity, gas, water, telephone service and trash collection. Lessee shall be responsible for maintaining the Premises in accordance with the terms hereof and shall be responsible for the payment of any costs or expense with respect to any janitorial services provided to the Premises, and Lessee shall be responsible for the trash or refuse disposal services to the trash or refuse generated by or related to the Premises.
At the commencement of the Initial Term, Lessee shall immediately transfer electric utility service from the name of

Lessor to the name of Lessee. If the Lessee fails to immediately transfer electric utility service to the name of Lessee, Lessor may, at its discretion, (i) direct the electric utility provider to discontinue service to the Premises in Lessor’s name, or (ii) make electric utility payments on behalf of Lessee and require that Lessee remit to Lessor full reimbursement for such payments together with a $100.00 administrative fee for each payment required to be made by Lessor.

Lessee shall not disconnect the electricity, gas or water at any time during the term of this Agreement, including in anticipation of the termination of the tenancy created herein. Upon termination of the term of this

Agreement, or in anticipation thereof, Lessee shall give Lessor reasonable written notice of its intent to disconnect electricity, gas and/or water service. Upon receipt of written notice to disconnect, Lessor may require, in its sole discretion, that Lessee cooperate with Lessor and do all things necessary to allow such utilities to be transferred into Lessor’s name prior to disconnection.
Section 12.01 - Signs:

Lessee, at its cost, shall have the right to place, construct and maintain an exterior sign on the Premises advertising its business conducted on the Premises. Such sign shall be located on the front exterior wall of the Premises above the front canopy extending from the front wall. Lessor shall have the right to approve such signs prior to their placement on the Premises, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, and any sign that Lessee has the right to place, construct and maintain shall comply with all applicable laws or regulations including, but not limited to the rules and regulations attached hereto as Schedule C and the design criteria attached hereto as Schedule D . Upon termination of the tenancy herein created, Lessee shall remove any sign so placed and repair any damage or injury to the Premises or the exterior thereof caused by such removal, and Lessee shall retain the contractor designated by Lessor to repair the damage caused by such removal. In the event the Lessee does not remove its sign as provided herein, then the Lessor shall have the right to remove the sign or signs and the Lessee shall be responsible for the payment of such removal and such cost or expense shall be considered as rent due hereunder.
In addition, Lessee must obtain prior written approval from Lessor of all Lessee exterior signage.
Should Lessee choose to place a sign under the Premises walkway, it must be erected by Hubbard Sign Company and paid for by the Lessee.
Section 13.01 - Access:

Lessor and its authorized representatives shall have the right after twelve (12) hours notice to Lessee, to enter the during Lessee’s business hours and at all other reasonable times with such prior notice for the purpose of:
A. Determining whether the Premises is in good condition and whether Lessee is complying with its obligations under this Agreement;

B. Doing any necessary maintenance and to make any restoration or repair to the Premises or the building and other improvements in which the Premises is located that Lessor has the right or obligation to perform.
C. Posting “for rent” or “for lease” signs during the last three (3) months of the term of this Agreement or any renewal thereof.
Section 14.01 - Indemnity:

Lessee shall hold Lessor harmless from all damages arising out of any loss, theft, injury or damage to any person or property (as the case may be) occurring in, on, or about the Premises except for damages resulting from the gross negligence or willful conduct of Lessor. Lessee shall be liable to Lessor for damages resulting from the acts or omissions of Lessee, its employees, officers, directors, shareholders, members, partners, representatives, agents, customers, guests, invitees and licensees or of Lessee's, its employee’s, officer’s, director’s, shareholder’s, member’s, partner’s, representative’s, agent’s, customer’s, guest’s, invitee’s and licensee’s negligence, gross negligence or willful conduct. Lessee’s obligation under this paragraph to indemnify and hold the Lessor harmless shall be limited to the sum that exceeds the amount of insurance proceeds, if any, received by the Lessor. The indemnitee shall give prompt notice to the indemnitor of any claim to which this indemnity applies.
Section 14.02 - Hazardous Substances:

Lessee warrants and covenants that neither the Lessee, nor its employees, agents, officers, shareholders, partners, members, invitees, guests or customers shall use, deposit, store, transport, locate, bring on to or cause to be brought on to the Premises any Hazardous Substances and further warrants and covenants that neither Lessee nor employees, agents, officers, shareholders, partners, members, invitees, guests or its customers shall release, discharge, spill, dispose, emit or permit the breakage of, Hazardous Substances in, on or under the Premises.

Lessee agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Lessor from any and all claims, damages, fines, judgements, penalties, costs, liabilities, or losses (including, without limitation, any and all sums paid for settlement of claims, attorneys' fees, consultant and expert fees) arising during or after the term of this Agreement or any renewal hereof from or in connection with the presence or suspected presence of Hazardous Substances in or on the Premises, which Hazardous Substances were brought onto the Premises during the term of this Agreement or any renewal thereof by the Lessee, its agents, officers, representatives, employees, invitees or licensees or become deposited or otherwise become present on the Premises during the term of this Agreement or any renewal thereof. Without limiting of the foregoing, this indemnification shall include any and all costs incurred due to any investigation of the site or any cleanup, removal, or restoration mandated by a federal, state, or local agency or political subdivision.

For purposes of this section, the term "Hazardous Substances" shall be interpreted broadly to include, but not be limited to, substances designated as hazardous under the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act of 1980, as amended, 42 U.S.C. 9601, et seq., the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act, 42 U.S.C. 2201, et seq., and any applicable State or federal law or regulation. The term shall also be interpreted to include but not be limited to any substance which after release into the environment and upon exposure, ingestion, inhalation or assimilation, either directly from the environment or directly by ingestion through food chains will or may reasonably be anticipated to cause death, disease, behavior abnormalities, cancer and/or genetic abnormaliti es, and oil and petroleum based derivatives.
The provisions of this section shall be in addition to any other obligations and liabilities Lessee may have to Lessor at law or in equity and shall survive the termination of this Agreement.
Section 15.01 - Insurance:

Lessee, at its cost, shall maintain comprehensive general liability insurance in a minimum amount of $1,000,000.00 for each occurrence with a $1,000,000.00 general aggregate, including $1,000,000.00 personal and advertising coverage, $100,000.00 in fire legal liability, and $5,000.00 in medical payments, insuring against all liability of Lessee arising out of and in connection with Lessee's use or occupancy of the Premises. All such insurance policies

shall name the Lessor as an additional insured. At the Commencement Date and on each anniversary date of the Commencement Date, Lessee shall supply to Lessor a certificate that such insurance is in force and the requisite premiums have been paid. Lessee's insurance policies and coverage shall be endorsed to apply on a primary basis. It is further provided that Lessee's insurance policies and coverage shall contain (either directly in the policy or by endorsement) a provision that provides that the Lessor shall be entitled to thirty (30) days prior written notice of cancellation and/or non renewal of such policy or coverage of the Lessee.

Lessor shall maintain fire, casualty and extended coverage insurance on the Boulevard Shopping Center Property and improvements thereon, and upon written request from the Lessee, the Lessor shall supply to Lessee a certificate establishing that such insurance is in force and the requisite premiums have been paid.
Section 16.01 - Waiver of Subrogation:

To the extent that a loss is covered by insurance in force and recovery is made for such loss, the Lessor and Lessee hereby mutually hold harmless and release each other from liability and waive all right of subrogation against each other for any loss or damage to their respective properties. Each party shall cause each insurance policy obtained by it to provide that the insurance company waives all right of recovery by way of subrogation against either party in connection with any liabilities or damage covered by any policy.
Section 17.01 - Damage or Destruction:

If casualty renders the Premises wholly unusable, as determined by Lessor acting in good faith and commercially reasonably, Lessor may terminate this Agreement by written notice. If not terminated, Lessor shall restore the roof, exterior walls, structural foundation, and other portions Lessor is obligated to maintain, and Lessee shall restore its improvements, fixtures, and other portions it is obligated to maintain. Rent shall abate proportionately while the Premises is unusable, except to the extent the casualty was caused by Lessee or persons for whom Lessee is responsible and the loss is not covered by insurance. If restoration is not substantially completed within one hundred eighty (180) days after restoration begins, either party may terminate by written notice delivered within ten (10) days after that period expires. Insurance proceeds and lender requirements control restoration funding to the extent permitted by Louisiana law. Section 18.01 - Lessee’s Default:
The following events shall be deemed to be events of default by Lessee under this Agreement:

A. Lessee shall be adjudged bankrupt, or shall file a voluntary petition in bankruptcy or make a general assignment for the benefit of Lessee's creditors, or a receiver by appointed for Lessee's property, or if execution be issued against Lessee's interest in this Agreement, or if Lessee's interest in this Agreement shall by operation of law pass to any person other than Lessee; or
B. Lessee shall fail to pay the rental due hereunder or any other amount payable to Lessor hereunder; or

C. Lessee shall fail to conduct business operations on the Premises and/or shall demonstrate other indicia of abandonment in such a manner that results in Lessor’s reasonable belief that Lessee has abandoned or vacated the Premises; or

D. Lessee shall fail to perform any requirements of this Agreement, other than a failure described in subsection 18.01(B) or 18.01 (C) above, and such failure shall continue for five (5) days after written notice of such failure from Lessor delivered to Lessee.

Upon the occurrence of any one or more of such events of default, at the option of Lessor, (i) this Agreement shall cease and terminate immediately and Lessee shall quit and surrender the Premises to Lessor, or (ii) Lessor may pursue any remedy available to Lessor, whether by law or contract, or in equity, including without limitation the repossession of the Premises by Lessor, in which event Lessee shall be liable for all rent payable through the date of repossession. If this Agreement shall have been terminated by Lessor pursuant to this Section 18.01, Lessor may at any time thereafter resume possession of the Premises by any lawful means, and remove Lessee and Lessee’s property therefrom. Time is of the essence with respect to all matters described in this Section 18.01.
Section 19.01 - Lessor’s Default:

Lessor shall be in default of this Agreement if it fails or refuses to perform any provision of this Agreement that it is obligated to perform if the failure to perform is not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice of the default has been given by Lessee to Lessor. If the default cannot reasonably be cured within thirty (30) days, Lessor shall not be in default of this Agreement if Lessor commences to cure the default within the thirty- day period and in good faith continues to cure the default. In the event the Lessor fails to cure a default as provided hereinabove and the continuance of such default results in the interruption of the Lessee's peaceable enjoyment of the Premises, then the Lessee shall be entitled to the abatement of the monthly rent payable under this Agreement and the amount of such abatement shall be in the same proportion as the amount of the Premises rendered unusable by Lessor's default is to the totality of the Premises.
Section 20.01 - Surrender of Premises:

Upon termination of this Agreement by lapse of time or otherwise, Lessee shall immediately surrender the Premises in as good condition as it was in at the beginning of the Initial Term, ordinary wear and tear and alterations, changes and additions made in compliance with this Agreement, acts of God, and other casualty excepted. In the event the Lessee retains possession of the Premises without exercising its option to renew in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and after the termination date of this Agreement, then the Lessee shall pay to the Lessor a monthly rental amount equal to 200% of the monthly rental amount set forth in Section 4.01 hereof for each month or part thereof that the Lessee retains possession of the Premises after the termination date of this Agreement.

Section 22.01 - Common Area, Non-Exclusive Cross Use Easement and Parking:

Lessor shall have the sole and exclusive control of the Common Area as well as the right to make changes to the Common Area. However, notwithstanding the foregoing, Lessor shall not be responsible for any harm or damage to the Lessee, its offices, employees, shareholders, agents or invitees as a result of the use by any person or persons of the Common Area. Lessor's rights with respect to the Common Area shall include, but not be limited to, the right to (i) restrict the use of the Common Area by unauthorized persons (ii) utilize from time to time any portion of the Common Area for promotional and related matters, (iii) temporarily close any portion of the Common Area for repairs, renovations, alterations or otherwise (iv) limit the activities or uses of the Common Area by the Lessee, its agents, invitees, and employees.

Each lessee of the Boulevard Shopping Center Property shall have a non- exclusive right to use and enjoy the Common Area, subject to the provisions contained in this Agreement. Provided however, in no event shall there be any overnight parking or storage of any boats, automobiles, trucks, recreational vehicles, campers or trucks larger than those having six wheels on the Boulevard Shopping Center Property. In addition, no lessee shall perform or permit to be performed any maintenance on any vehicles in the Common Area. All delivery vehicles owned and operated by any lessee in connection with its business located in the Boulevard Shopping Center shall be parked at all times, during business and non-business hours in the rear of the lessee’s leased premises.
Section 23.01 - Interpretation:
This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Louisiana.
Section 24.01 - Waiver:

No delay or omission by either party in exercising any right occurring upon any noncompliance or default by the other party with respect to any of the terms hereof shall impair any such or be construed to be waiver thereof. A waiver by either party of any of the covenants and agreements to be performed by the other shall not be construed to be a waiver of any succeeding breach thereof or of any other covenants or agreements herein contained.
Section 25.01 - Heirs and Successors:

Subject to the provisions hereof pertaining to assignment and subletting, the covenants and agreements of this Agreement shall be binding upon the heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns of the parties hereto.
Section 26.01 - Integrated Agreement; Modification:
This Agreement contains all of the agreements of the parties and cannot be amended or modified except by a written agreement signed by the Lessor and the Lessee.
Section 27.01 - Recordation:
This Agreement shall not be recorded, except that if either party requests the other party to do so, the parties shall execute a memorandum of lease in recordable form.
Section 28.01 - Captions:
The captions used in this Agreement shall have no effect of its interpretation.
Section 29.01 - Severability:
The unenforceability, invalidity, or illegality of any provision of this Agreement shall not render the other provisions unenforceable, invalid or illegal.
Section 30.01 - Attorney's Costs:

If, by reason of a default by Lessee, Lessor retains an attorney to enforce this Agreement or notify Lessee of default, Lessee shall reimburse Lessor for its reasonable attorneys' fees, costs, and notice-delivery expenses within thirty (30) days after written demand. In any suit arising from this Agreement, the prevailing party shall recover reasonable attorneys' fees and costs to the extent permitted by Louisiana law. [LOUISIANA COUNSEL REVIEW]

Lessee must exercise the option by written notice at least sixty (60) days before expiration; untimely notice terminates the option. SCHEDULE C
BOULEVARD SHOPPING CENTER PROPERTY
RULES & REGULATIONS

All loading and unloading shall occur only at designated times, areas, and entrances. Garbage and refuse shall be kept in Landlord-designated containers and collection areas. No exterior antenna, loudspeaker, display, obstruction, solicitation, offensive noise or odor, or unauthorized item outside the Premises is permitted. Lessee shall keep adjoining areas clean, use designated employee parking, maintain qualified pest-control service, protect plumbing and utilities, display its name and address at the rear door, and maintain rear security lighting all night. Lessee shall operate at least Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; stated holidays are excepted. A violation of operating hours may result in a fine up to $100 per occurrence, and five or more occurrences in twelve months gives Lessor an additional termination right. Illuminated signs shall remain lit from dusk until midnight.

SCHEDULE D
BOULEVARD SHOPPING CENTER PROPERTY
DESIGN CRITERIA FOR LESSEE SIGNS

Store identity signs only. No freestanding signs. Exterior signage shall be manufactured by Universal Sign Company unless Lessor approves another vendor. Letters may not exceed 26 inches high or 80% of storefront frontage and shall remain at least two feet from corners. No exposed neon, paper, flashing, moving, or audible signs without approval. Door/window letters may not exceed six inches. Submit separate drawings, colors, construction, attachment details, and storefront elevations for written approval before ordering or installation. Approved illuminated signs operate automatically from dusk until midnight.
